text: “And she might credit it. Similarly she mightn’t.” Joe felt, as I did, that he had made a point there, and he pulled hard at his pipe to keep himself from weakening it by repetition. “You see, Pip,” Joe pursued, as soon as he was past that danger, “Miss Havisham done the handsome thing by you. When Miss Havisham done the handsome thing by you, she called me back to say to me as that were all.” “Yes, Joe. I heard her.” “ALL,” Joe repeated, very emphatically.
